title: Bengali Hallucination Detection with Retrieval and Programs: A System Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.22892v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Bengali hallucination detection must distinguish unsupported factual claims from incorrect reasoning, often without a supplied reference passage. We present and characterize an inference-only system that combines response-conditioned query rewriting, hybrid retrieval, and task-specific language-model judging. Six retrieval routes search question-answer and passage collections; a router directs each example to a 27B textual judge or a 14B agent that can compare retrieved answers, reason directly, or generate and execute Python. We characterize the system using version-specific code, saved predictions, execution traces, and corpus metadata from the Olikbochon challenge. Kaggle associates a displayed private macro-F1 of 0.956 with Version 2; its saved run processes 2,516 examples in 220.99 minutes on two T4 GPUs. Of 253 math-routed examples, 88 terminate through candidate matching, while execution traces expose 49 stderr-bearing run events

translated_title: 基于检索与程序的孟加拉语幻觉检测：一项系统研究
translated_abstract: 孟加拉语幻觉检测必须在缺乏参考文本的情况下，区分无事实依据的声明与错误推理。我们提出并描述了一个仅用于推理的系统，该系统结合了基于响应的条件查询重写、混合检索以及任务特定的语言模型评判。系统设有六条检索路径来搜索问答和文本集合；路由器将每个样本导向27B参数的文本评判模型或14B参数的智能体，后者可以比较检索到的答案、直接推理，或生成并执行Python代码。我们使用来自Olikbochon挑战赛的特定版本代码、保存的预测结果、执行轨迹和语料库元数据对系统进行了特征分析。Kaggle显示版本2的私有macro-F1分数为0.956；其保存的运行记录在两块T4 GPU上用220.99分钟处理了2,516个样本。在253个被路由到数学处理的样本中，88个通过候选匹配终止，而执行轨迹揭示了49个包含stderr的运行事件。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个结合查询重写、混合检索和语言模型评判的仅推理孟加拉语幻觉检测系统，在Kaggle竞赛中取得了0.956的macro-F1分数。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an inference-only Bengali hallucination detection system combining response-conditioned query rewriting, hybrid retrieval, and language-model judging, achieving a 0.956 private macro-F1 score in the Olikbochon Kaggle challenge.
